termination: manual Ctrl+C after an independent read-only preflight review identified a correctness defect while the process was still in memory

defects.description: The auxiliary witness history was reset on the first unsuppressed C3 instantaneous substitution candidate. Because a raw C4 PLANT/MAIN candidate necessarily crosses the slightly lower frozen C3 instantaneous gate, witness readiness was lost after the first of the three persistence samples, making the intended three-sample veto effectively unreachable.
The evaluator and development verifier used different attribution-runtime summary key names.

scientific_handling: These are implementation/preflight defects, not observed C4 development outcomes. Fixes may restore the already-declared mechanism and evidence schema, but attribution thresholds, persistence counts, go/no-go criteria, and V3 behavior remain frozen. The corrected evaluator must receive a new hash and a new pre-development config before the first completed 105-run matrix.
